titre: Applying for a middle school or high school grant
resume: Automatic assessment at enrollment or an application before October 15: income limits, amounts, the tax notice to provide and the rules when parents are separated or have shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: The bourse de collège (middle school grant) and the bourse de lycée (high school grant) help low-income families pay school costs. They are paid every term. For the 2026-2027 school year, what counts is the reference tax income (revenu fiscal de référence) on the 2026 tax notice for 2025 income. Most of the time you apply by agreeing to automatic assessment when you enroll your child.
quiEstConcerne: Families of a middle or high school student attending a public school, a state-contracted private school (privé sous contrat) or the Cned (national distance-learning center) in a full class.
Parents of a child in CM2 (last year of primary school) moving up to 6e (first year of collège), or in 3e moving up to high school.
Separated parents: only one parent can apply.
aSavoir: Middle school grant 2026-2027: €40, €112 or €175 per term depending on income. 2025 income limits: €18,488 for 1 dependent child, €22,754 for 2, €27,020 for 3, €31,286 for 4, €35,553 for 5.
High school grant 2026-2027: 6 levels (échelons), from €168 to €357 per term. The official simulator tells you your level.
Married or civil-partnership (PACS) couple: one joint tax notice. Unmarried couple living together: each partner's tax notice. Single parent living alone: only your tax notice.
Shared residence (middle school grant): the parents choose which of them applies. If both submit an application, both are rejected.

Agreeing to automatic assessment at enrollment in a public school counts as an application for the child's whole time in middle and high school. Without this agreement, you must apply again every year.
Paid in 3 installments. For a child who eats at the canteen (demi-pensionnaire) or boards (interne), canteen or boarding fees are deducted first.

etapes.detail: Online on Scolarité services with EduConnect, or on a paper form at the school office.
Full 2026 tax notice, RIB, signed form, residence judgment if you are separated. With shared residence, agree on who applies.
If refused in middle school, you can appeal within 2 months. In high school, 15 full days (jours francs) after the notice.
